source_inventory.summary: Main skill (v3.2, 2026-10-18, CRLF). Sec 0 operational flow (5 steps: ask domain, curl scan, Markdown report template, How-to-Implement prompt block template, deliver). Sec 1 pass-criteria tables for 23 checks in 5 categories (4+1+3+10+5). Sec 2 levels 0-5. Sec 3 API reference (endpoint, 3 required headers, request body with 23 enabledChecks keys, format agent, MCP server, isitagentready.com own endpoints table, response JSON schema, status values). Sec 4 Web UI vs API table. Sec 5 batch Python. Sec 6 index of 25 sub-skill links. Sec 7 priority order (5). Sec 8 25 prompt templates (23 checks + llmsTxt + llmsFullTxt; ap2 without Skill line), each followed by a Sub-skill relative link.

Human README. Mostly duplicates SKILL.md. Unique: quick-start curl without enabledChecks, curl with format agent, scan_site call args, filled example report (Level 1, stale denominators), generic Goal/Issue/Fix/Skill/Docs field legend, batch Python variant printing level, concrete response JSON example, Sources table (11 URLs), note that no ap2 folder exists. Obsolete: 23-check table, level code block, skill tree, file counts (24 vs 25 sub-skills).

Meta sub-skill: when to use (4), POST request with format agent, parameters url (required, valid HTTP/HTTPS) and format (agent or json default), MCP server scan_site, interpretation of JSON format (5 bullets incl. status pass/fail/unableToCheck) and agent format (3 bullets), level scale table. Says 22 standards (conflict).
RFC 9309; 3 requirements; Cloudflare AI Crawl Control; validate checks.discoverability.robotsTxt.status.
Sitemaps protocol; 4 requirements; validate checks.discoverability.sitemap.status.
RFC 8288 + RFC 9727 sec 3; 4 requirements (4 relation types, example header); Cloudflare Transform Rules/Workers; validate checks.discoverability.linkHeaders.status.
DNS-AID; 4 requirements; SVCB dns example; DoH validation (cloudflare-dns.com fallback dns.google, ScanOptions.dohResolverUrl disables fallback); 2 references (draft, RFC 9460).

9 AI bot names; 3 requirements (wildcard alone insufficient); AI Crawl Control; validate checks.botAccessControl.robotsTxtAiRules.status.
contentsignals.org + IETF draft; 3 requirements; example directive; AI Crawl Control; validate checks.botAccessControl.contentSignals.status.

IETF WebBotAuth WG; 4 requirements (JWKS path, >=1 public key, sign requests, Signature-Agent and Signature-Input headers); Cloudflare Web Bot Auth; validate checks.botAccessControl.webBotAuth.status.
RFC 9727; 4 requirements (linkset+json, anchor, service-desc/service-doc/optional status, Appendix A); validate checks.discovery.apiCatalog.status.

OIDC Discovery + RFC 8414; 3 requirements (paths, issuer/authorization_endpoint/token_endpoint/jwks_uri, grant_types_supported + response_types_supported); Cloudflare Access; validate checks.discovery.oauthDiscovery.status.

RFC 9728; 5 requirements (resource, authorization_servers, optional scopes_supported, optional WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata on 401); Workers + Access; validate checks.discovery.oauthProtectedResource.status.

Auth.md; 7 requirements (H1 contains auth.md, PRM fields incl. bearer_methods_supported header, AS metadata issuer match, agent_auth block, self-contained fallback); Flow Metadata for ID-JAG, verified email, anonymous; never probe POST /agent/auth; validate checks.discovery.authMd.status; 3 references.
SEP-1649 (PR 2127); 4 requirements; Agents SDK/Workers; validate checks.discovery.mcpServerCard.status.
A2A spec; 4 requirements; Agent Discovery link; Agents SDK; validate checks.discovery.a2aAgentCard.status.
Agent Skills Discovery RFC v0.2.0; $schema URL; skills entry fields name/type/description/url/digest (5); validate checks.discovery.agentSkills.status.
WebMCP; 5 requirements using navigator.modelContext.registerTool() and AbortController (conflicts with provideContext() in parent); validate checks.discovery.webMcp.status.

ARD v0.9 draft / ai-catalog; specVersion note; 7 requirements (CORS *, exactly one of url or data per spec 3.4, urn:air identifiers, 2-5 representativeQueries); JSON example; 4 additional discovery mechanisms (Agentmap robots directive, link rel ai-catalog, _catalog TXT, _search SRV); validate checks.discovery.ard.status.

Poppy draft 0.1, informational; website-only poppy.json example; domain matching rules; session-enabled interfaces need auth.issuer; 5 issuer RFC 8414 metadata rules; issuer path example; no secrets; publish only working capabilities; verify issuerValidation values (verified, notRequired, unverified, invalid, notChecked) and unableToCheck.
x402; 4 requirements (@x402/express, @x402/hono, @x402/next, facilitator URL + wallet, HTTP 402); validate checks.commerce.x402.status.
MPP; 4 requirements (openapi.json, x-payment-info intent/method/amount, optional currency/description/x-service-info); OpenAPI JSON example; validate checks.commerce.mpp.status; 2 references.
UCP; 3 requirements; validate checks.commerce.ucp.status.
ACP; 5 requirements (protocol.name acp, protocol.version, absolute api_base_url, non-empty transports, non-empty capabilities.services); validate checks.commerce.acp.status.

GEO v1.1 (ft.ia.br, Apache 2.0). Quick Actions menu (7, default Full GEO Audit). Workflow: 1 measurement (50-100 prompts, Citation Rate), 2 terminology (example), 3 roundup page format (5 required elements, 8-12 products), 4 community signals, 4.5 Cloudflare agent-friendly content architecture (llms.txt sharding, grep loop, /index.md fallback, hidden HTML directive code block, AI training crawler redirects, markdown negotiation 80% and client list, rich frontmatter, misplaced community bullet), 5 JSON-LD/FAQPage/Product + robots allows AI crawlers, 6 weekly/model-update monitoring. Quality checklist (9).
6 principles (5 duplicate SKILL.md workflow; unique: one high-signal page outperforms dozens of thin pages) + Product Hunt 2026 case-study attribution.

Substack v1.1 (ft.ia.br, Apache 2.0). Parameters table (topic, goal, language). Workflow: clarify scope (default SEO metadata + outline), visual formatting, SEO fields (title 40-60, slug 3-5 keywords no numbers/dates, meta 155-160, alt text), growth (Notes, recommendations rotation 30-60 days, monthly analytics), monetization (Tease and Convert, VIP outreach 4-5 stars, welcome email with 3 best articles, Tags taxonomy). Pull Quote centering procedure; hierarchy (H1-H3, 3-5 sentence paragraphs, inline styles, lists/dividers); Block vs Pull quote; image widths standard/wide/full, caption + alt text; native/custom buttons, polls exclusive to paying subscribers; subject line rules (under 50 chars, no ALL CAPS/excess exclamation/spam phrases Buy Now, Act Now, spam-score test).

Few-shot: input prompt (smartwatches for digital nomads), output table (title, meta description, slug with notes), 3 SEO rules applied. Meta description in example is 137 chars, contradicting its own 155-160 note.

GEO: generative engine optimization, AEO, AI SEO, LLM citation rate, AI visibility, optimize for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overview, roundup pages, FAQPage schema. # Web Discoverability: one scope line, no intro prose

## Mode Router: table Mode | Trigger phrases | Load | Default action. SCAN (agent ready, isitagentready, agent readiness, agent-ready score, scan a domain) -> references/scan-api.md + references/fix-prompts.md. IMPLEMENT (named check, RFC 9727/8288/9728, SEP-1649, WebMCP, ARD, x402, UCP, ACP, fix a failing check) -> the matching references/implement-*.md. GEO (GEO, AEO, AI SEO, LLM optimization, citation rate, AI visibility, optimize for ChatGPT, roundup pages) -> references/geo.md, default Full GEO Audit. NEWSLETTER (Substack, newsletter, post SEO, Notes, paid conversion) -> references/newsletter.md, default goal format + seo. Chaining rules: SCAN failures -> IMPLEMENT; GEO step 4.5 -> implement-discoverability-content.md and implement-bot-access.md

## SCAN: Core Flow: Step 1 ask-domain quote verbatim; Step 2 curl block verbatim (23 enabledChecks); Step 3 build report from scan-api.md template; Step 4 one prompt block per check with status fail or neutral from fix-prompts.md; Step 5 present report, write to requested path on request; usage example block (README You/Agent lines 18-22) verbatim
## Levels: merged 6-row table (Level 0 = Fewer than 2 of: robots.txt, sitemap, Link headers)
## Priority Order: 5 items verbatim from SKILL.md sec 7

## Check Index: 25 rows (23 scored + llmsTxt, llmsFullTxt unscored) with columns Check | API key | JSON category key | Pass criteria (verbatim from SKILL.md sec 1) | Guide anchor | Template anchor; scoring notes (Commerce scored only when e-commerce signals detected; webBotAuth neutral does not affect score; personalAgentProtocol does not affect level or score)

## IMPLEMENT: Core Rules: open the guide anchor; apply the stricter resolutions (scopes_supported, response_types_supported, API catalog status relation, MCP card at server-card.json, agent-skills at new path, full User-Agent); re-run scan and Check checks.<category>.<key>.status is pass
## GEO: Core Rules: present the 7-item Quick Actions menu (pointer to geo.md); default to option 1; measure Citation Rate before edits
## NEWSLETTER: Core Rules: resolve topic, goal, language parameters (pointer to newsletter.md); default goals format + seo
## Cross-Mode Conflict Rules: GEO crawler access vs Content-Signal ai-input/ai-train choices; llms.txt sharding vs single llms.txt; WebMCP provideContext vs registerTool

## Output Gates: SCAN report has every category and one prompt per fail/neutral check; IMPLEMENT shows pass on re-scan (or deployed-file check for llms files); GEO 9-item checklist; NEWSLETTER 8-item checklist
## Reference Index: 8 files with one-line purpose and relative links

INVENTORY: 33 source files (agent-ready-cloudflare 27: SKILL.md, README.md, 25 nested sub-skill SKILL.md; geo-optimization 2; substack-expert 3), about 10,376 words. All are markdown with CRLF line endings. No binaries or images, and no scripts or assets. The brief said 23 nested folders; the actual count is 25 (scan-site, llms-txt and llms-full-txt included; ap2 absent).

LAYOUT: 9 target files instead of 33. SKILL.md is the router. references/ holds scan-api.md, fix-prompts.md, implement-discoverability-content.md, implement-bot-access.md, implement-api-auth-mcp.md, implement-commerce.md, geo.md and newsletter.md. The nested sub-skills are grouped by scanner category: Discoverability and Content are merged because llms.txt, markdown negotiation and the GEO /index.md rules belong together. scan-site goes into scan-api.md. Estimated total after rewrite is about 9,550 words, most of it verbatim code, JSON and templates. SKILL.md will be about 1,400 words and well under 500 lines.

MODE ROUTER:
- SCAN: load scan-api.md + fix-prompts.md and run Steps 1-5.
- IMPLEMENT: load only the implement-<category>.md that holds the check, using the Check Index in SKILL.md (API key -> JSON category key -> guide anchor -> template anchor), then re-scan to validate.
- GEO: load geo.md, default action Full GEO Audit (quick action 1). Step 4.5 hands off to the implement files.
- NEWSLETTER: load newsletter.md, default goal format + seo, language matches the user's message.
- SCAN feeds IMPLEMENT automatically when a check fails.
